notes: Cold outbound for DRD Sports. Two sequences, both aimed at the ORGANISATION:
clubs (owners, directors, technical directors) and school athletics (athletic
directors). Both buy the website and player-database build.
PARENTS ARE DELIBERATELY NOT HERE. Dr. D's 1:1 coaching sells to parents, but a
parent's address is a personal address, not a business contact published in a
work role. The conspicuous-publication basis almost certainly does not reach it,
and cold-emailing individuals is a different legal question entirely. Parents
come through the club relationship or an express opt-in funnel, never from here.
Copy rules applied: no guaranteed outcomes, no implied institutional endorsement,
no unverifiable geography claims, no em dashes, and a real way out in every step.
Three steps, not six. Research found nobody leaves a vendor over a missing
cold-email feature, but everybody notices a seventh follow-up.

send_window.why: Weekday mornings in the mailbox timezone. Monday to Thursday only: Friday afternoon mail to a club director gets read Monday at the bottom of a pile.

clubs.name: DRD Sports — clubs, player records and site
clubs.audience: Club directors, presidents, technical directors at soccer, hockey, basketball and multi-sport clubs

steps.subject: {{company}} player records
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I build player databases and websites for {{category|sports}} organisations. Most clubs I speak to are holding rosters, stats and family contact details across a few spreadsheets, with a website nobody can update without calling someone.

What that build usually looks like:

- One record per athlete: profile, stats, video, academic info
- A site your coaches update themselves, no developer in the loop
- A clean export an athlete and their family can send to a recruiter

Worth 15 minutes to see whether it fits how {{company}} actually runs?

Andre de Freitas
DRD Sports

steps.subject: Re: {{company}} player records
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

One thing that comes up with nearly every club: parents asking what NIL means for their kid, and nobody on staff wanting to be the one to answer it.

I teach that side as well, separately from the build:

- A plain-language session for parents and athletes on NIL and AI tools
- The player record system that puts an athlete's case together without a coach writing it up by hand

If the timing is wrong, say so and I will stop here.

Andre

steps.subject: Closing the loop on {{company}}
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Leaving this with you. If a player database or a site your coaches can run themselves becomes useful to {{company}} later, reply and I will pick it up then.

If it is not relevant, no reply needed. I will not follow up again.

Andre

school_athletics.name: DRD Sports — school athletics, athlete records
school_athletics.audience: Athletic directors and assistant athletic directors at secondary and prep programmes

steps.subject: Athlete records at {{company}}
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I build athlete record systems and websites for athletic departments. The pattern I keep running into: eligibility, rosters and stats live in three different places, and when a student needs something for a recruiter it gets assembled by hand.

What the build covers:

- One athlete record across every team and season
- Stats and eligibility in the same place as the roster
- A site your coaches maintain without going through IT

Is that worth 15 minutes of your time?

Andre de Freitas
DRD Sports

steps.subject: Re: Athlete records at {{company}}
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

The other half of what I do, in case it is the more useful half for {{company}}:

- Sessions for athletes and families on NIL and on using AI tools properly
- Staff-facing guidance so coaches are not improvising answers to parents

I run those independently of any build, so it does not have to be a package.

If this is not your file, tell me who owns it and I will go to them instead.

Andre

steps.subject: Closing the loop on {{company}}
steps.body:

Leaving it here. If athlete records or the family-facing sessions come up at {{company}} down the line, reply to this and I will pick it up.

Otherwise no reply needed, and I will not follow up again.

Andre
